text:
[issue by Stoupy51]
### Bug Description

Technical Issue with atlases and overlays in resource pack.

In Stoupy51/LifeSteal#13, a user report their game crashing when opening a chest with a particuliar item model (accepted by vanilla Minecraft), their crash report is given in the "log file" part of this issue.

In LifeStealFR, to avoid "multiple atlas" problem with 1.21.11+ and keeping compatibility with version range of 1.21.5 - 26.1+, the item model [`assets/life_steal/models/item/revive_beacon.json`](https://github.com/Stoupy51/LifeSteal/blob/main/build/resource_pack/assets/life_steal/models/item/revive_beacon.json) references textures that are added to either the ["blocks" atlas](https://github.com/Stoupy51/LifeSteal/blob/main/build/resource_pack/before_format_73/assets/minecraft/atlases/blocks.json) (before 1.21.11) or ["items" atlas](https://github.com/Stoupy51/LifeSteal/blob/main/build/resource_pack/format_73_plus/assets/minecraft/atlases/items.json) (starting 1.21.11) depending on the pack overlay
```json
...
"overlays": {
	"entries": [
		{"formats": [0,72],"directory": "before_format_73","min_format": 0,"max_format": 72},
		{"formats": [73,1000],"directory": "format_73_plus","min_format": 73,"max_format": 1000}
	]
}
```

Removing this behavior on my side would either mean I would have to duplicate the vanilla texture in the pack as proper .png files instead of reused the default ones, or drop compatibility for previous 1.21.11 versions.

In my opinion, ModernFix should be able to resolve the atlas reference (if I correctly understand what is happening)

### Reproduction Steps

Download and Enable the LifeStealFR resource pack: https://github.com/Stoupy51/LifeSteal/releases/tag/v2.0.1

Type `/give @s stone[item_model="life_steal:revive_beacon"]` => this will crash your game
